content.text: You are watching a robotic gripper completing a task from the viewpoint of its wrist camera. Several colored trajectories are overlaid on the screen. Which of these trajectories will result in the robot correctly picking the lotion container in front of the robot and placing it next to the other lotion on the far right? Choices:  A. The purple trajectory. B. The orange trajectory. C. The red trajectory. D. The pink trajectory. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
